**Chinese name:** 上海壁仞智能科技有限公司 (Shànghǎi Bìrèn Zhìnéng Kējì Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded September 2019 by former SenseTime president Zhang Wen and former Huawei engineer Jiao Guofang; one of two Chinese GPU startups (with Moore Threads) directly named in the US Commerce Department's October 17, 2023 Entity List action targeting AI chip designers with a Foreign Direct Product Rule designation, the most restrictive tier. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's main board on January 2, 2026 — the first new HK listing of the year and, at the time, the largest IPO under HKEX's 18C mechanism for pre-revenue/early-revenue specialist technology companies — issuing about 248 million shares at HK$19.60, with the stock surging as much as 110% on debut (closing around +94.6%).
:::

## What does this firm design?

General-purpose GPUs for AI compute, led by the BR100 series, competing directly in the segment most exposed to Nvidia export restrictions. H1 2026 revenue reached approximately ¥1.236 billion, up roughly 2,000% year-on-year, reflecting a sharp commercialization acceleration despite the Entity List designation.
